visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a clean white blouse, stands centrally in a well-lit indoor environment. A medical clinic logo is visible in the top-left corner. She holds a medical device with a pale green handle and a long, thin needle probe, smiling while looking directly at the camera. (2) The woman brings the device closer to her face, pointing it toward her jawline and nasolabial folds to demonstrate its intended use. She uses her fingers to manipulate the skin around her mouth, explaining the procedure while shifting her gaze between the camera and the device. (3) The scene shifts to a static branding screen featuring the clinic's logo in a large, stylized font. Beneath the logo, multiple rows of contact information appear, including a LINE ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text.
